name: labs/ap--__python-seabreeze
title: Ocean Optics spectrometer (python-seabreeze Spectrometer)
intro: Ocean Optics spectrometer (python-seabreeze Spectrometer), adapted from ap--/python-seabreeze. It reads `pixel_count`, `max_intensity`, `serial_number` and `model_name`; runs `measure_intensity` and `set_integration_time`. `measure_intensity`: measure optical or radiant intensity at a declared wavelength or channel and return the value with its unit and integration time. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
